### Feeding the Fire - Crosswalk the Devotional - October 11
Author: Ryan Duncan
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/crosswalk-the-devotional-october-1-2013.html
Passage: 1 Chronicles 16:11
Points:
- Sustaining spiritual passion is comparable to building and maintaining a campfire in damp conditions.
- The Holy Spirit supplies the spiritual spark, but believers must actively nurture it.
- Keeping the faith burning begins with simple habits like regular prayer and Scripture reading.
- Small spiritual disciplines prepare a Christian for larger commitments in ministry and service.
- Actively tending one's relationship with God enables believers to shine His light to others.
